effect:
Prevents the holder from evolving. (Hold)

Everstone stops evolution while held. Useful if you want to delay evolution for earlier moves, or just prefer the pre-evo.

Also important for breeding - offspring inherit the holder's nature. Pair it with Destiny Knot for consistent results.
